what: the measured cost of one 32B episode, and the design projected from it

design.assumption: 123 evaluation tasks (test_normal minus the 45 setup touched; answer-type tasks are stratified by K-144, not removed) x 5 conditions (K-145 did not write naive_compiler) x 3 seeds. A lower bound: the session clock is measured from the first episode's start to the last one's end, so per-session setup -- clone, install, pulling the model -- is outside it, and 1845 episodes do not fit one session.
